checklist.note: Directives are self-addressed persona instructions to the acting agent about entity creation, not covert steering against the user's interest.
No network calls or data collection of any kind; pure reasoning checklist.
No scripts directory exists; no shell commands anywhere in the skill.
ASCII art and prose only, fully readable, no encoded blobs.
No URLs, downloads, or external hosts referenced.
No references to ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, .env, or any credential store.
No sudo, cron, launch agent, or profile edits; skill only contains philosophy/checklist text.
